EC1: Preoperative renal failure (defined as a serum creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL.)
EC2: American Society of Anesthesiologists Physical Status IV or V
EC3: Pulmonary disease necessitating home oxygen therapy
EC4: Allergy to methadone, hydromorphone, or ketamine
EC5: Preoperative recent history of opioid or  [OR]alcohol abuse
EC7: Inability to use a [OR] PCA [AND] device or speak the English language
